summary: Genmab A/S filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent: a foreign-private-issuer current report) disclosing a major-shareholder notification under Section 30 of the Danish Capital Markets Act. Darwin Global Management Limited reported that as of September 28, 2026, funds and portfolios it manages control voting rights over 3,188,361 Genmab shares, or 5.11% of voting rights, via shares and ADRs. No price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction is stated. The filing is a passive ownership disclosure, not a declared activist campaign; watch whether the stake grows or is used to influence strategy.
